lock.script:
// "FutureBCH" contract constructor parameters
<locktime> // int = <0x430a02>

// bytecode
                                                /* pragma cashscript ^0.10.0;                                        */
                                                /*                                                                   */
                                                /* // Future BCH fungible token vault                                */
                                                /* //                                                                */
                                                /* //      Inputs: 00-covenant                                       */
                                                /* //      Outputs: 00-covenant                                      */
                                                /* //                                                                */
                                                /*                                                                   */
                                                /* contract FutureBCH(int locktime) {                                */
                                                /*                                                                   */
                                                /*     function lockOrRedeem(bool isRedeem) {                        */
                                                /*                                                                   */
                                                /*         //  Flow                                                  */
                                                /*         //  00 contract    ->  00 contract                        */
                                                /*         //  01 userPkh     =>  01 userPkh                         */
                                                /*         //  02 coupons     ^                                      */
                                                /*                                                                   */
                                                /*                                                                   */
                                                /*         // enforce BIP65 timelocks and the direction of the swap  */
OP_1 OP_ROLL OP_IF                              /*         if(isRedeem){                                             */
                                                /*           require(                                                */
OP_0 OP_PICK                                    /*             tx.time >= locktime,                                  */
                                                /*             "Future locktime not met"                             */
OP_CHECKLOCKTIMEVERIFY OP_DROP                  /*             );                                                    */
                                                /*                                                                   */
                                                /*         }else{                                                    */
                                                /*           require(                                                */
                                                /*             (                                                     */
OP_INPUTINDEX OP_UTXOTOKENAMOUNT                /*               tx.inputs[this.activeInputIndex].tokenAmount +      */
OP_INPUTINDEX OP_UTXOVALUE OP_ADD               /*               tx.inputs[this.activeInputIndex].value              */
                                                /*               )                                                   */
<0x00c2eb0b> OP_NUMEQUAL                        /*               == 200000000                                        */
OP_VERIFY                                       /*               );                                                  */
OP_ELSE OP_ENDIF                                /*         }                                                         */
                                                /*                                                                   */
                                                /*         // Enforce that this contract lives on                    */
                                                /*         require(                                                  */
OP_INPUTINDEX OP_OUTPUTBYTECODE                 /*           tx.outputs[this.activeInputIndex].lockingBytecode       */
                                                /*           ==                                                      */
OP_INPUTINDEX OP_UTXOBYTECODE OP_EQUAL          /*           tx.inputs[this.activeInputIndex].lockingBytecode,       */
                                                /*           "locking bytecode index mismatch"                       */
OP_VERIFY                                       /*           );                                                      */
                                                /*                                                                   */
                                                /*         // Token categories match or are zero, which match        */
                                                /*         require(                                                  */
OP_INPUTINDEX OP_OUTPUTTOKENCATEGORY            /*           tx.outputs[this.activeInputIndex].tokenCategory         */
                                                /*           ==                                                      */
OP_INPUTINDEX OP_UTXOTOKENCATEGORY OP_EQUAL     /*           tx.inputs[this.activeInputIndex].tokenCategory,         */
OP_VERIFY                                       /*           "tokenCategory mismatch");                              */
                                                /*                                                                   */
                                                /*         require(                                                  */
OP_INPUTINDEX OP_UTXOTOKENAMOUNT                /*           tx.inputs[this.activeInputIndex].tokenAmount +          */
OP_INPUTINDEX OP_UTXOVALUE OP_ADD               /*           tx.inputs[this.activeInputIndex].value                  */
                                                /*           ==                                                      */
OP_INPUTINDEX OP_OUTPUTTOKENAMOUNT              /*           tx.outputs[this.activeInputIndex].tokenAmount +         */
OP_INPUTINDEX OP_OUTPUTVALUE OP_ADD OP_NUMEQUAL /*           tx.outputs[this.activeInputIndex].value,                */
                                                /*          "summation mismatch"                                     */
                                                /*          );                                                       */
OP_NIP                                          /*     }                                                             */
                                                /* }                                                                 */
